description: Answer a restaurant question with a card or a map. Use a restaurant name for a card, or a violation term plus a city for a map (for example pest inspections in Milwaukee). Hosts that support MCP Apps render the card or map inline. The text result still names the matches for hosts that only show text.

city.description: City scope. Required for a violation map.

query.description: Restaurant name, or a violation word when violation is omitted.

view.description: card, map, or auto. auto uses a card for a restaurant and a map for a violation search.

violation.description: Violation text to map, such as pest, roach, or dropping.

name: show_inspection
